reason: Both answers reach the same correct conclusion: drop "AI" and "PM", lead with capacity/utilization forecasting, sell to execs at 20–150 person agencies, and offer an overlay option. A adds a useful "audit your top 15 accounts" validation step and a concrete demo flow. B adds a clearer wedge framing (PM tools are capacity-blind, resource tools go stale), hero copy built on the asker's own phrasing, a named enemy, and an explicit overlay-versus-all-in-one fork. B also includes some unsourced numbers (80%, $100k), a mild weakness. Overall quality is comparable.
